notes.title: Jet Attack Demo Update!
notes.content:
We've updated the Jet Attack Demo to include six missions and co-op multiplayer. Missions include Carrier Operations, F-117 strikes, protecting Air Force One and Apache Strike. You can also choose from one of 5 jets in co-op multiplayer. Play on our dedicated servers located in US, UAE, EU and Australia.

The full game will include over 100+ missions, multiple multiplayer modes, 10+ game modes, a mission editor and more! Wishlist today to be notified when the full release is available
